nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $x \in S$. The conductor ideal of the subalgebra $R[x]$ of $S$ generated by $x$ equals the conductor of $x$, the ideal of all $a \in S$ such that $ab \in R[x]$ for every $b \in S$.
nodes.title: Conductor of a monogenic subalgebra

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $T$ be an $R$-subalgebra of $K$. Then the conductor ideal of the image of $R$ in $T$ (the smallest $R$-subalgebra of $T$) is nonzero if and only if $T$ is finitely generated as an $R$-module.
nodes.title: Finiteness of an overring via its conductor

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be an algebra over $O$, where $O$ and $B$ are commutative rings, with structure map $\varphi : O \to B$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a maximal ideal of $B$ and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $B$ with $\mathfrak c \not\subseteq \mathfrak q$ such that for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$ there is $o \in O$ with $\varphi(o) = xb$. Then the index of $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ in $O$ equals the index of…
nodes.title: Equal ideal indices away from a denominator-clearing ideal

nodes.summary: Contraction after extension is the identity on primes not containing `𝔠`.
nodes.title: Contraction after extension fixes primes away from the conductor

nodes.summary: Contraction of a nonzero ideal is nonzero when `𝔠` is nonzero: a nonzero element of `𝔠` clears a nonzero element of `𝔮` back to a nonzero element of the contraction.
nodes.title: Contraction of a nonzero ideal is nonzero

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $T$ be an $R$-subalgebra of $K$ that is finitely generated as an $R$-module. Then the conductor ideal of the image of $R$ in $T$ (the smallest $R$-subalgebra of $T$) is nonzero.
nodes.title: A finite overring has nonzero conductor

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $S$ and $T$ commutative $R$-algebras, $f \colon S \to T$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras and $B$ an $R$-subalgebra of $T$. Then the preimage under $f$ of the conductor ideal of $B$ is contained in the conductor ideal of the subalgebra $f^{-1}(B)$ of $S$.
nodes.title: Preimage of a conductor ideal

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $A$ an $R$-subalgebra of $S$. The conductor ideal of $A$ is all of $S$ if and only if $A = S$.
nodes.title: The conductor ideal is the unit ideal only for the whole algebra

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $A \subseteq B$ two $R$-subalgebras of $S$. Then the conductor ideal of $A$ is contained in the conductor ideal of $B$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the conductor ideal

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $A$ an $R$-subalgebra of $S$. Then the conductor ideal of $A$ is contained in $A$.
nodes.title: The conductor ideal lies in the subalgebra

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring and $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra. The conductor ideal of $S$, viewed as an $R$-subalgebra of itself, is the unit ideal $S$.
nodes.title: Conductor ideal of the whole algebra

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra and $A$ an $R$-subalgebra of $S$. The conductor ideal of $A$ is the ideal of $S$ consisting of all $s \in S$ such that $st \in A$ for every $t \in S$; it is the largest ideal of $S$ contained in $A$.
nodes.title: Conductor ideal of a subalgebra

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring, $K$ a field that is an $R$-algebra, and $T$ an $R$-subalgebra of $K$. If the conductor ideal of the image of $R$ in $T$ (the smallest $R$-subalgebra of $T$) is nonzero, then $T$ is finitely generated as an $R$-module.
nodes.title: A subalgebra of a field with nonzero conductor is finite

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $\overline{R}$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $K$, viewed as an $R$-algebra. The conductor ideal of the smallest $R$-subalgebra of $\overline{R}$ (the image of $R$) is a nonzero ideal of $\overline{R}$ if and only if $\overline{R}$ is finitely generated as an $R$-module.
nodes.title: Finiteness of the integral closure via the conductor

nodes.summary: Let $O$ and $B$ be commutative rings, let $B$ be an $O$-algebra whose structure map $f \colon O \to B$ is injective, let $\mathfrak p$ be a maximal ideal of $O$, and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $O$ with $\mathfrak c + \mathfrak p = O$ such that $f(x)\,b$ lies in the image of $f$ for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$. Then the ideal $\mathfrak p B$ of $B$ generated by $f(\mathfrak p)$ is maximal.
nodes.title: Maximal ideals stay maximal under denominator clearing

nodes.summary: In dimension at most one, nonzero primes extend to maximal ideals under denominator clearing. Let $O$ and $B$ be commutative rings such that every nonzero prime ideal of $O$ is maximal, let $B$ be an $O$-algebra whose structure map $f \colon O \to B$ is injective, let $\mathfrak p$ be a nonzero prime ideal of $O$, and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $O$ with $\mathfrak c + \mathfrak p = O$ such that $f(x)\,b$ lies…
nodes.title: In dimension at most one, nonzero primes extend to maximal ideals under denominator clearing

nodes.summary: Let $O$ and $B$ be commutative rings, let $B$ be an $O$-algebra whose structure map $f \colon O \to B$ is injective, let $\mathfrak p$ be a prime ideal of $O$, and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $O$ with $\mathfrak c + \mathfrak p = O$ such that $f(x)\,b$ lies in the image of $f$ for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$. Then the ideal $\mathfrak p B$ of $B$ generated by $f(\mathfrak p)$ is prime.
nodes.title: Prime ideals stay prime under denominator clearing

nodes.summary: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative semirings with $S$ an $R$-algebra, let $A$ be an $R$-subalgebra of $S$, and let $I$ be an ideal of $S$. Then $I$ is contained in the conductor ideal of $A$ if and only if $I$ is contained in $A$.
nodes.title: Universal property of the conductor ideal

nodes.summary: Extension after contraction is the identity on primes of `B` not containing `𝔠.map f`, using that `B` has Krull dimension at most one.
nodes.title: Extension after contraction fixes primes away from the conductor

nodes.summary: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative semirings with $S$ an $R$-algebra, and let $A$ be an $R$-subalgebra of $S$. An element $s \in S$ lies in the conductor ideal of $A$ if and only if $st \in A$ for every $t \in S$.
nodes.title: Membership in the conductor ideal

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be an algebra over $O$, where $O$ and $B$ are commutative rings, with structure map $\varphi : O \to B$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a maximal ideal of $B$ and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $B$ with $\mathfrak c \not\subseteq \mathfrak q$ such that for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$ there is $o \in O$ with $\varphi(o) = xb$. Then $O / \varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ and $B / \mathfrak q$ have the same…
nodes.title: Equal cardinality of residue rings away from a denominator-clearing ideal

nodes.summary: Contraction and extension give an equivalence between the nonzero primes of `B` not containing `𝔠.map (algebraMap O B)` and the nonzero primes of `O` not containing `𝔠`. This is the restriction of `Ideal.primeEquivOfNotLeConductor` to nonzero prime ideals.
nodes.title: Bijection of nonzero primes away from the conductor

nodes.summary: Contraction and extension give an equivalence between all primes of `B` not containing `𝔠.map (algebraMap O B)` and all primes of `O` not containing `𝔠`, including the zero prime on both sides. This restores the full spectra in ATLAS `NumberTheoryI` Corollary 6.27.
nodes.title: Bijection of primes away from the conductor

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be an algebra over $O$, where $O$ and $B$ are commutative rings, with structure map $\varphi : O \to B$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a maximal ideal of $B$ and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $B$ with $\mathfrak c \not\subseteq \mathfrak q$ such that for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$ there is $o \in O$ with $\varphi(o) = xb$. Then for every $o \in O$, the residue-ring isomorphism…
nodes.title: The residue-ring isomorphism on residue classes

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be an algebra over $O$, where $O$ and $B$ are commutative rings, with structure map $\varphi : O \to B$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a maximal ideal of $B$ and let $\mathfrak c$ be an ideal of $B$ with $\mathfrak c \not\subseteq \mathfrak q$ such that for every $x \in \mathfrak c$ and every $b \in B$ there is $o \in O$ with $\varphi(o) = xb$. This is the ring isomorphism…
nodes.title: Residue-ring isomorphism away from a denominator-clearing ideal

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
